name: goblin_oriflamme_bonus_only_for_your_attacking_creatures
notes: P97166045ed G4. Printed: 'Attacking creatures you control get +1/+0.' Seat 0 attacks with its 2/2 and keeps its 3/3 home: the attacker deals 3 (seat 1 at 17). After combat neither creature is attacking: the 2/2 is 2 power again and the 3/3 never changed. On seat 1's turn seat 1's 2/2 attacks seat 0 and deals only 2 (an opponent's attacker gets nothing).
